g.title: cSDH_QSP
g.text: Chronic Subdural Haematoma — Quantitative Systems Pharmacology Map
dV/dt = J_exudation + J_rebleed − J_absorption · the haematoma is a secreting organ, not a failing clot
red = the two self-sustaining loops · blue = drug action · green = clearance · thick = the volume balance

g.text: ⑤ Starling exchange: the exudation term J_ex

g.title: cluster_rebleed

g.title: cluster_clear
g.text: ⑧ Clearance routes: the absorption term J_abs

g.title: cluster_mech
g.text: ⑩ Intracranial mechanics: atrophy, the double-edged variable
